title: Minimum Cost Path with Alternating Directions I
summary: Start at grid cell (0,0), paying its entry cost. Each entry to (i,j) costs (i+1)*(j+1). Movement alternates: first move right/down, next left/up, and so on, always staying in the grid. Return the minimum cost to reach the opposite corner, or -1 if unreachable. The reference wording about the initial entry's move number is inconsistent; its worked example uses the first displacement as odd. Resolve that wording before certifying requirements.
